messages.author: e4c6cbb632d0dc23
messages.subject: Bar plot in descending order
parts:
Hi all
I have this bar chart, but I want to show the bars in descending order, so that the label of each can be ordered.
the code I used was this:
gplot1<-ggplot(subfamilias2, aes(x=Subfamilia, y=Respuesta)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="black", colour="black",width=0.5)
gplot1 + facet_grid(Variables~.,scales="free")+labs(x="Subfamilias", y="")+theme(strip.text = element_text(size=rel(1)),strip.background = element_rect(fill="lightgrey", colour="black",size=1))+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family="Times",colour="black",angle=30, hjust=1, vjust=1))


Any idea?

Thanks 

Daniel

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Bar plot in descending order
parts:
Hi:

You could use the reorder() function on Subfamilia, but the problem is
that it will order the categories the same way in both panels. It will
likely order correctly for one panel but not quite correctly in the
other. If you insist on having independent orders in each panel, then
you'll have to create the panels one by one, save in separate ggplot
objects and use something like grid.arrange in the gridExtra package
to piece them together...but that approach may raise other issues
(e.g., horizontal alignment of the panels).

Dennis
